exhibits.title: The Weather Dashboard
exhibits.causeOfDeath: The layout was scheduled for tomorrow. Tomorrow never came.
exhibits.plaque: A dashboard that promised to show the weather in five cities at once. It showed it in one, on desktop only, on good days.

uncle.line: Ach, Junge. Forty days of commits and then "tomorrow just the layout". In 1998 we finished things. Mostly.

quest.title: #3 Mobile layout breaks below 400px
quest.why: It is the bug that stopped you, so it is the bug that brings you back.

exhibits.title: Habit Tracker 3000
exhibits.causeOfDeath: Lost the habit of working on the habit tracker.
exhibits.plaque: Started on New Year's Day to track daily habits. Its own streak ended on January 19.

uncle.line: A habit tracker that lasted eighteen days. Na ja, that is still longer than my diet.

quest.title: #1 Streak counter resets at midnight UTC
quest.why: One timezone fix and the streaks finally mean something.

exhibits.title: Rewrite It In Rust
exhibits.causeOfDeath: Lost to the borrow checker on points.
exhibits.plaque: An ambitious plan to rewrite a working shell script in Rust. The shell script is still in use today.

uncle.line: Forty-seven rounds against the borrow checker. Respect, Junge. But the shell script still works, ja?

quest.title: Make it start again on a modern runtime
quest.why: There are no open issues. There is also no working code. Start there.
